Map a numeric findings domain to CTAS input

Input_Numeric.Rd

Produces one CTAS timeseries per subject and test code from a plain numeric findings domain such as VS. Values are used as-is; use Input_Range() when reference ranges are available and values must be made comparable across tests.

Usage

Input_Numeric(
  dfDomain,
  strSubjectCol = "USUBJID",
  strTestCDCol = "VSTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "VSTEST",
  strValueCol = "VSSTRESN",
  strVisitCol = "VISIT",
  strVisitNumCol = "VISITNUM",
  strVisitPattern = NULL,
  strExcludePattern = "unsch",
  strCategory = "Vital Signs",
  strPrefix = "VS"
)

Arguments

dfDomain

data.frame An SDTM domain.

strSubjectCol

character Subject identifier column.

strTestCDCol

character Short test-code column.

strTestCol

character Long test-name column. Falls back to strTestCDCol when NULL.

strValueCol

character Result column.

strVisitCol

character Name of the visit column.

strVisitNumCol

character Numeric visit-order column.

strVisitPattern

character Regular expression that a visit must match to be retained. NULL (default) keeps all visits.

strExcludePattern

character Regular expression whose matches are dropped. Matched case-insensitively. Default "unsch" removes unscheduled visits. NULL disables the exclusion.

strCategory

character Value written to parameter_category_1, used as the display grouping in downstream tools.

strPrefix

character Prefix for the generated parameter_id.

Value

list with elements data, parameters and untransformed, ready to be passed to Combine_CTAS_Input().

Details

The function is named for the data type, not the SDTM domain, so the same code serves VS, EG or any other numeric findings domain. Domain-specific knowledge lives in the column arguments, supplied from the workflow YAML.

Examples

Input_Numeric(data.frame(
  USUBJID = c("S1", "S1"),
  VSTESTCD = c("SYSBP", "SYSBP"),
  VSTEST = c("Systolic Blood Pressure", "Systolic Blood Pressure"),
  VISIT = c("WEEK 2", "WEEK 4"),
  VISITNUM = c(3, 4),
  VSSTRESN = c(120, 124)
))
#> $data
#>   subject_id parameter_id timepoint_1_name timepoint_2_name timepoint_rank
#> 1         S1     VS_SYSBP           WEEK 2             <NA>              1
#> 2         S1     VS_SYSBP           WEEK 4             <NA>              2
#>   result baseline
#> 1    120       NA
#> 2    124       NA
#> 
#> $parameters
#>   parameter_id                       parameter_name parameter_category_1
#> 1     VS_SYSBP Vital Signs: Systolic Blood Pressure          Vital Signs
#>   parameter_category_2 parameter_category_3
#> 1             VS_SYSBP              numeric
#> 
#> $untransformed
#>   subject_id parameter_category_2 timepoint_1_name original_value lower upper
#> 1         S1             VS_SYSBP           WEEK 2            120    NA    NA
#> 2         S1             VS_SYSBP           WEEK 4            124    NA    NA
#>   original_category
#> 1              <NA>
#> 2              <NA>
#>
